verdict.rationale: Increase documents wire origination via `POST /wire_transfers`, RTP sending with instant settlement, and FedNow sending with Routing Number reachability checks and ACH/wire fallback. Each rail has its own documentation page, and the Routing Numbers API exposes per-rail reachability. Inbound wires and RTP are documented through unique Account Numbers and the receipt solutions page, and a community user confirms the wire and RTP offering. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of FedNow receipt, detailed per-rail capability specs (limits, operating hours), and independent hands-on corroboration of FedNow.
